brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
brokers.note: Two pricing tiers: IBKR Lite offers $0 commissions on US stocks/ETFs (US residents); IBKR Pro uses per-share commissions with SmartRouting and lower margin rates. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.

brokers.name: SoFi Invest
brokers.note: Active Investing offers $0 commissions on stocks and ETFs, no account minimum, and fractional shares from $5; taxable, Traditional, Roth, and SEP IRAs available. Light on advanced research and trading tools; margin accounts require $2,000. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.

brokers.name: Tastytrade
brokers.note: Options-first broker (owned by IG Group): stocks/ETFs trade at $0; options cost $1 per contract to open (capped at $10 per leg) and $0 to close; futures $1 per contract. No account minimum. US residents only. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.

brokers.name: J.P. Morgan Self-Directed Investing
brokers.note: Chase-integrated brokerage: $0 commission online stock/ETF trades, no account minimum, and fractional shares from $5 (S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 stocks plus select ETFs). Intro/funding bonuses omitted as they change often. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.

brokers.name: Merrill Edge Self-Directed
brokers.note: Bank of America-integrated brokerage: unlimited $0 online stock, ETF and option trades with no trade or balance minimums and no annual account fee (options contract fees apply). No fractional shares. Intro/funding bonuses omitted as they change often. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.

brokers.name: Ally Invest
brokers.note: Ally Bank-integrated brokerage: $0 commission on most U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs, no account minimum, and no fractional shares. Options are $0.50 per contract. Intro/funding bonuses omitted as they change often. Verify current terms on the broker's site before opening an account.
